ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PathOnClient)), OR( LOWER(RIGHT(PathOnClient, 5)) = ".html", LOWER(RIGHT(PathOnClient, 4)) = ".htm", LOWER(RIGHT(PathOnClient, 4)) = ".mht", LOWER(RIGHT(PathOnClient, 4)) = ".svg", LOWER(RIGHT(PathOnClient, 4)) = ".swf", LOWER(RIGHT(PathOnClient, 4)) = ".htt", LOWER(RIGHT(PathOnClient, 6)) = ".xhtml", LOWER(RIGHT(PathOnClient, 6)) = ".thtml" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: HTML files (.html and .htm) are not allowed for upload.
